name: Blade Armor
description: Reflects basic attack damage back to the attacker and reduces critical damage taken.
passive: Vengeance - When taking damage from basic attacks, deals physical damage equal to 25% of incoming damage plus 25% of hero's physical defense back to the attacker and slows them by 15% for 1s.

name: Dominance Ice
description: Crucial anti-heal and anti-attack speed aura item that debilitates marksmen and sustain bruisers.
passive: Arctic Cold - Reduces attack speed of nearby enemy heroes to 70% of base value. Lifebane - Reduces shield and HP regen of nearby enemies by 50%.

name: Antique Cuirass
description: Essential physical armor against skill-reliant physical assassins and fighters.
passive: Deter - When hit by an enemy hero's skill, reduces their physical attack by 8% for 2s, stacking up to 3 times (max 24% physical attack reduction).

name: Athena's Shield
description: Primary magic defense item offering massive burst magic damage reduction upon taking magic hits.
passive: Shield - Triggered when taking magic damage. Reduces magic damage taken by 25% for 3s (cools down after 5s out of combat).

name: Radiant Armor
description: Sustained magic defense armor engineered to counter continuous and multi-hit magic damage.
passive: Holy Blessing - Taking magic damage increases magic damage reduction by 6-20 (scales with level) for 3s, stacking up to 6 times.

name: Oracle
description: Enhances shield capacity and HP regen rate, highly synergistic with sustain fighters and tanks.
passive: Bless - Increases shield absorption effects and HP regeneration received by 30%.

name: Brute Force Breastplate
description: Offensive and defensive armor granting stacking hybrid defense, movement speed, and crowd control resilience.
passive: Brute Force - Dealing damage grants 6 physical attack/magic power, 4 hybrid defense, and 2% movement speed per stack for 4s (up to 6 stacks). At max stacks, grants 15% CC duration reduction.

name: Twilight Armor
description: Protects against high single-hit physical burst and periodically deals AoE magic damage based on HP.
passive: Twilight - Caps single-instance physical damage exceeding 600, reducing excess damage by 20%. Dealing damage also inflicts bonus magic damage equal to 35 + 5% extra HP.

name: Immortality
description: Resurrects the fallen hero upon defeat, offering a critical second chance in teamfights.
passive: Immortal - Resurrects 2.5s after death with 16% max HP and a 220-1200 shield that lasts 3s (cooldown 210s).

name: Queen's Wings
description: Clutch survival item granting drastic damage reduction, cooldown refund, and hybrid lifesteal at low HP.
passive: Demonize - When HP drops below 40%, gains 30% damage reduction for 3s, resets skill cooldowns by 2s, and increases hybrid lifesteal by 15% (cooldown 60s).

name: Guardian Helmet
description: Massive flat HP boost providing continuous out-of-combat health regeneration without needing to recall.
passive: Recovery - Regenerates 2.5% max HP per second outside combat. Each kill or assist increases regen by 0.5% max HP per second (up to 3.5%).

name: Thunder Belt
description: Defensive item that permanently stacks hybrid defense and delivers slowing true damage on basic attacks.
passive: Thunderbolt - After casting a skill, the next basic attack deals 50 + 5% total HP true damage, slows enemies by 40-80%, and permanently grants 1 physical defense and 1 magic defense when hitting an enemy hero.

name: Cursed Helmet
description: Tank wave-clearing and jungle-burn armor radiating continuous magic burn damage.
passive: Burning Soul - Deals magic damage equal to 1.2% max HP per second to nearby enemies (damage increased by 140% against minions and creeps).

name: Blade of Despair
description: The highest flat physical damage weapon in MLBB, granting execution power against weakened foes.
passive: Despair - Attacking enemy units with HP below 50% grants 25% extra physical attack for 2s.

name: Malefic Roar
description: Armor-shredding firearm that penetrates tank physical defense proportionally to their armor value.
passive: Armor Buster - When attacking an enemy, gains 0.125% bonus physical penetration for each point of the enemy's physical defense (capped at 40% bonus penetration).

name: Demon Hunter Sword
description: Anti-tank basic attack weapon dealing current HP percentage damage on hit with stacking lifesteal.
passive: Devour - Basic attacks deal 8% of the target's current HP as additional physical damage. Each basic attack grants 3% physical lifesteal for 3s (up to 5 stacks).

name: Endless Battle
description: All-around physical sustain and burst weapon infusing basic attacks with true damage following skill usage.
passive: Divine Justice - After using a skill, the next basic attack deals 60% physical attack as additional true damage (1.5s cooldown) and grants 10% movement speed.

name: War Axe
description: Brawler battleaxe that stacks physical damage, cooldown reduction, spell vamp, and true damage in combat.
passive: Fighting Spirit - Dealing damage grants 12 physical attack and 2% extra spell vamp per stack every second up to 6 stacks. At max stacks, deals 10% extra true damage based on original damage.

name: Sea Halberd
description: Physical anti-heal polearm cutting enemy regeneration and shields while punishing high-HP targets.
passive: Lifebane - Dealing damage reduces enemy shield and HP regen by 50% for 3s. Punish - Increases damage dealt by 8% against enemy heroes with higher extra HP.

name: Rose Gold Meteor
description: Hybrid offensive weapon granting magic resistance and an automatic life-saving shield at low HP.
passive: Lifeline - When HP drops below 30%, immediately gains a 510-1350 point shield and 25 magic defense for 3s (40s cooldown).

name: Wind of Nature
description: Marksman weapon with an active ability that grants 2 seconds of total immunity to all physical damage.
passive: Wind Chant (Active) - Grants immunity to all physical damage for 2s (1s for non-Marksman heroes). Cooldown: 70s.

name: Berserker's Fury
description: Premier critical strike item massively boosting critical chance, critical multiplier, and physical attack.
passive: Doom - Critical hits grant 5% extra physical attack for 2s.

name: Haas's Claws
description: Sustained combat claws delivering top-tier lifesteal, critical chance, and bonus attack speed on crits.
passive: Frenzy - Critical strikes grant 20% extra attack speed for 2s.

name: Windtalker
description: Fast-firing weapon providing attack speed, movement speed, and bouncing magic cyclone procs.
passive: Typhoon - Every 5-3s, basic attack triggers a typhoon dealing 150-362 magic damage to up to 3 enemies (can crit). Each typhoon cast increases movement speed by 5%.

name: Hunter Strike
description: Assassin penetration weapon giving high cooldown reduction, flat armor penetration, and rapid speed bursts.
passive: Retribution - Dealing damage to the same enemy hero or creep 5 times in a row increases movement speed by 50% that decays over 3s (cooldown 8s).

name: Blade of the Heptaseas
description: Ambush dagger that dramatically empowers the next basic attack after leaving combat or stalking in bushes.
passive: Ambush - If no damage is taken or dealt within 5s, the next basic attack deals 160 + 40% physical attack as bonus physical damage and slows target by 40% for 1.5s.

name: Corrosion Scythe
description: On-hit slowing scythe that continuously ramps up self attack speed while impeding enemy retreat.
passive: Corrosion - Basic attacks deal 80 bonus physical damage and slow enemy target by 8% (stacks up to 5 times). Impulse - Basic attacks grant 6% attack speed for 3s (stacks up to 5 times).

name: Golden Staff
description: Converts all critical strike chance into flat attack speed and triggers on-hit effects twice every 3 hits.
passive: Swift - Cannot deal critical hits; each 1% critical strike chance gained is converted into 1% attack speed. Endless Strike - Every 3rd basic attack triggers on-hit effects 2 extra times.

name: Great Dragon Spear
description: Physical lance providing attack, cooldown reduction, crit chance, and high burst movement speed after casting Ultimate.
passive: Supreme Warrior - After casting Ultimate, gains 15% movement speed that decays over 7.5s (cooldown 15s).

name: Malefic Gun
description: Marksman firearm providing extended basic attack range and movement speed on hit.
passive: Malefic Energy - Active: Increases basic attack range by 15% for 3s. Passive: Basic attacks grant 10% movement speed for 1s.

name: Scarlet Phantom
description: Classic critical attack speed weapon that spikes attack speed and critical rate on critical hits.
passive: Frenzy - Critical hits increase the hero's attack speed by 30% and crit chance by 5% for 2s.

name: Holy Crystal
description: Apex magic amplifier scaling total magic power by up to 35% for maximum late-game spell burst.
passive: Mystery - Increases total magic power by 21-35% (scales with hero level).

name: Divine Glaive
description: Magic penetration staff that cuts through high enemy magic resistance proportionally.
passive: Spellbreaker - When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% bonus magic penetration for each point of the enemy's magic defense (capped at 20% bonus).

name: Blood Wings
description: Ultimate mage item granting colossal magic power, bonus HP, and a regenerable magic shield.
passive: Guard - Generates a shield absorbing 800 + 100% magic power. When shield breaks, gains 30 movement speed for 1s. Shield regenerates after 20s out of combat.

name: Glowing Wand
description: Inflicts continuous burn damage based on target max HP and applies anti-heal (Lifebane) to negate healing and shields.
passive: Scorch - Magic damage burns targets for 3s, dealing magic damage equal to 1.5% of target's max HP per second. Lifebane - Reduces enemy shield and HP regen by 50% for 3s.

name: Ice Queen Wand
description: Slowing scepter that reduces enemy movement speed by up to 30% upon hitting them with skills.
passive: Ice Bound - Skills dealing damage to enemy heroes slow them by 10% for 2s, stacking up to 3 times (max 30% slow).

name: Lightning Truncheon
description: AoE magic burst weapon releasing bouncing lightning bolts that scale with total magic power.
passive: Resonate - Every 6s, the next skill resonates, dealing 50-1000 magic damage (scales with magic power) to up to 3 enemies and granting 30% movement speed for 2s.

name: Clock of Destiny
description: Scaling mage item providing magic power, mana, and stacking hybrid defense upon hitting skills.
passive: Destiny - Dealing magic damage to enemy heroes grants 4-8 hybrid defense per stack for 5s (up to 6 stacks). At max stacks, recovers 5% max HP and mana.

name: Genius Wand
description: Early-to-mid game flat magic defense shredder reducing enemy magic defense on every spell hit.
passive: Magic - Dealing damage to enemy heroes reduces their magic defense by 3-7 (scales with level) for 2s, stacking up to 3 times.

name: Concentrated Energy
description: Primary spell lifesteal item providing sustained healing and ramping magic power in prolonged fights.
passive: Recharge - Dealing magic damage grants 5 bonus magic power for 5s, up to 6 stacks. At max stacks, increases magic damage dealt by 12%.

name: Enchanted Talisman
description: Essential mana book providing continuous max mana regeneration and raising the cooldown reduction cap.
passive: Mana Spring - Regenerates 15% max mana every 10s. Stream - Increases maximum cooldown reduction cap by 5% (up to 45%).

name: Fleeting Time
description: Ultimate-reset artifact instantly refunding 30% of Ultimate cooldown on hero kills or assists.
passive: Timestream - Hero kills or assists immediately reduce the current cooldown of the hero's Ultimate by 30%.

name: Winter Crown
description: Universal stasis survival item allowing heroes to freeze and become invulnerable for 2 seconds while continuing channeled skills.
passive: Frozen (Active) - Enter a frozen state for 2s, becoming immune to all damage and CC, but unable to move or attack (active skills continue channeling). Cooldown: 100s.

name: Feather of Heaven
description: Attack speed magic artifact adding scaling bonus magic damage to basic attacks.
passive: Affliction - Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage equal to 50 + 30% magic power. Impulse - Basic attacks grant 6% attack speed for 3s, up to 5 stacks.

name: Starlium Scythe
description: Empowers basic attacks with true damage following skill casts, tailored for hybrid magic assassins.
passive: Crisis - After casting a skill, the next basic attack deals 100 + 100% magic power as true damage and grants 10% movement speed (1.5s cooldown).

name: Wishing Lantern
description: Artillery magic lantern unleashing homing butterflies that deal percentage current HP magic damage to tanky targets.
passive: Butterfly Goddess - For every 800 magic damage dealt to an enemy hero, unleashes a Butterfly dealing magic damage equal to 10% of their current HP.

name: Necklace of Durance
description: Classic magic anti-heal amulet that cuts enemy healing and shields by 50% upon dealing damage.
passive: Lifebane - Dealing damage reduces enemy shield and HP regen effects by 50% for 3s.

name: Warrior Boots
description: Physical defense boots granting stacking armor against enemy basic attacks.
passive: Valor - Physical defense increases by 4 each time a basic attack is received, up to 20 bonus defense (lasts 3s).

name: Tough Boots
description: Magic resistance footwear reducing the duration of crowd control effects by 30%.
passive: Fortitude - Reduces duration of crowd control effects (stuns, slows, freezes) by 30%.

name: Arcane Boots
description: Magic penetration boots maximizing early damage burst for mages and magic assassins.
passive: Penetration - Increases flat magic penetration by 10.

name: Rapid Boots
description: Fastest boots in the game, providing massive out-of-combat movement speed for roamers.
passive: Side Effect - Dealing or taking damage slows the hero's movement speed by 25 for 5s.

name: Magic Shoes
description: Utility footwear granting 10% cooldown reduction for skill-reliant heroes.
passive: Cooldown - Increases cooldown reduction by 10%.

name: Swift Boots
description: Attack speed boots favored by marksmen and basic attack carries.
passive: Agility - Increases attack speed by 15%.

name: Demon Shoes
description: Mana regeneration boots replenishing mana on minion and hero eliminations.
passive: Mysticism - Eliminating enemy heroes or assists recovers 10% max mana. Eliminating minions recovers 4% max mana.

name: Ice Retribution
description: Jungler retribution spell upgrade that steals movement speed from the targeted enemy hero.
passive: Hunter - Retribution deals 100 true damage to heroes, steals 72-100 movement speed from them for 3s, and deals 150% damage to creeps.

name: Flame Retribution
description: Jungler retribution spell upgrade that siphons physical attack and magic power from the enemy hero.
passive: Hunter - Retribution deals 100 true damage to heroes and steals 32-52 physical attack and magic power from the target for 3s.

name: Bloody Retribution
description: Tank jungler retribution spell upgrade that siphons enemy HP based on self extra HP over 3s.
passive: Hunter - Retribution deals true damage to enemy heroes equal to 250 + 12% of user's extra HP over 3s while healing the user for the same amount.

name: Behemoth's Hunter
description: Tough Boots blessed with Bloody Retribution, maximizing resilience and jungle HP drain for tank junglers.
passive: Fortitude & Bloody Hunter - Reduces CC duration by 30% and upgrades Retribution to siphon 250 + 12% extra HP over 3s.

name: Flame Hunter
description: Swift Boots blessed with Flame Retribution, providing attack speed and attack-stealing power for carry junglers.
passive: Agility & Flame Hunter - Grants 15% attack speed and upgrades Retribution to steal 32-52 attack power from the target.

name: Ice Hunter
description: Warrior Boots blessed with Ice Retribution, granting physical defense and movement speed theft for fighter junglers.
passive: Valor & Ice Hunter - Grants stacking physical defense and upgrades Retribution to steal enemy movement speed.

name: Star Shard
description: Classic magical jungle item providing magic power, mana regen, and stacking creep damage.
passive: Gorge - Defeating jungle creeps increases damage dealt by 0.5%, up to 15 stacks.

name: Conceal
description: Active roaming blessing granting camouflage and massive team movement speed for surprise teamfight initiation.
passive: Conceal (Active) - Grants concealment and 30-75% movement speed to user and nearby allies for 5s (cooldown 80s). Ends upon dealing or taking damage.

name: Dire Hit
description: Lethal roaming blessing executing weakened enemies with bonus percentage max HP hybrid damage.
passive: Dire Hit - When damaging an enemy hero whose HP is below 35%, deals extra hybrid damage equal to 7-18% of target's max HP (30s cooldown).

name: Encourage
description: Support aura blessing providing physical attack, magic power, and attack speed to all nearby allies.
passive: Encourage - Grants nearby allied heroes 13-33 physical attack and magic power, plus 9-18% attack speed.

name: Favor
description: Healing roaming blessing granting large burst HP restoration to the most wounded ally when using heal or shield skills.
passive: Favor - Casting a heal or shield skill restores an additional 300-750 HP to the nearby allied hero with the lowest HP (10s cooldown).

name: Courage Mask
description: Classic active roaming mask providing team-wide movement speed acceleration and attack power buff.
passive: Encourage (Active) - Increases movement speed of self and nearby allies by 30% and raises physical/magic attack by 20% for 3s (cooldown 80s).

name: Shadow Mask
description: Classic roaming mask granting team camouflage and movement speed to reposition unseen.
passive: Conceal (Active) - Enters camouflage state with nearby teammates for 5s, boosting movement speed by 15% (cooldown 80s).
